headline: Fisherman's Row Tilts to Wardens as Viper Pit Flares Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition the ledger has tilted on Fisherman's Row: Warden troops have carried four works in the past day, Arcadia and Eidolo have borne the heaviest pounding, and one installation now stands demolished between the lines. The Viper Pit has reopened about Blackthroat, five actions inside two hours and the latest logged as this dispatch went to press. Weathered Expanse remains the war's busiest ground, fifty-eight actions in a day, Wightwalk struck twenty-four times and Frostmarch sixteen, the last stroke recorded at the filing hour. Stlican Shelf's tug-of-war between Breaker Town and The Pale House continues, though casualty rates there have slackened. Linn of Mercy bleeds afresh about The First Coin, Warden losses running near three hundred the hour, while Stonecradle's grind about The Cord quickens and Callahan's Passage, costing better than thirteen thousand casualties in a day, has seen The Latch pass to the Colonials, the sole work of their color on that front. The Dead Lands and Godcrofts have fallen quiet, their latest actions logged hours before this edition. The ledger reads 282 works Colonial, 151 Warden, three demolished; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
